# HWP/HWPX regression corpus

## Fixture policy

- The generated fixture contains only original HEXORA test text and no third-party exam content. The repository currently has no declared root-level license, so this fixture is not separately labeled CC0 or offered for redistribution outside the repository.
- Third-party exam papers, school worksheets, publisher material, and user uploads are not copied here unless redistribution permission is documented.
- Every future external fixture must include its source, license, redistribution permission, and a reviewed golden result.

## Current coverage

| Fixture | Format | Source | Coverage |
|---|---|---|---|
| hexora-original-prefix-answer.hwpx (generated in test) | HWPX | Original OWPML generated by the test | Reader, question prefix numbering, choices, numbered answer key, assembly |

## Remaining corpus gap

No redistributable, real-world binary HWP (.hwp) sample has been approved for this repository yet. The synthetic HWPX fixture validates the OWPML reading path but does not claim to represent every Hancom Office version or document-authoring workflow. Issue #36 must remain open until licensed real HWP/HWPX samples and human-reviewed golden IR files are available.
